title: A Multilingual, Culture-First Approach to Addressing Misgendering in LLM Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-generated summaries of meeting transcripts across 42 languages using both human annotators and LLM-as-a-judge. The evaluation measures two specific metrics: Gender Mistake (GM), which checks if incorrect gendered terms are used when a person's gender is explicitly specified, and Gender Assumption (GA), which checks if a specific gender is assumed when no gender information is provided in the context.
